profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Shutterstock
profile.summary:
Senior Software Engineer working in complex problem using front end using React/Node JS/Material UI technology.

Education WES verify : http://t.cred.ly/l/5394a36b-30b9-4741-ad98-1ac67d57ba0e

Google AI Essential: https://www.credly.com/badges/ef5ffe96-23c7-4a8e-b11d-7a4cf01a7bd5/public_url

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Own end-to-end development of production services, including system design, implementation, automated testing, deployment, monitoring, incident response, and uptime.
- Build scalable, performant frontend applications using React, Next.js, TypeScript, Material UI, SASS, and CSS Modules.
- Design and implement backend services and RESTful APIs using Node.js and Express, integrating with internal and external systems.
- Use GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, and OpenAI Codex for AI-assisted coding, code exploration, refactoring, unit test generation, debugging, documentation, and implementation planning.
- Apply agentic coding practices to break down engineering work, provide repository context, execute iterative changes, validate results, and keep human review and production safeguards in the loop.
- Create and use reusable AI skills that package repeatable instructions, workflows, and engineering conventions for consistent execution across development tasks.
- Use Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers to connect AI coding tools with approved repositories, documentation, development utilities, and other contextual systems.
- Follow GitHub Flow with focused branches, incremental commits, pull requests, automated checks, peer review, and safe merge practices.
- Collaborate with Product, UX, and Data teams to deliver customer-facing features that improve experience and drive revenue.
- Implement feature flags, progressive rollouts, and A/B experiments using LaunchDarkly, decoupling release from deployment.
- Drive AI-assisted experimentation using ChatGPT for translation, content generation, ideation, and rapid prototyping.
- Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines with Jenkins and GitHub-based development workflows.
- Monitor, debug, and optimize systems using New Relic, Grafana, Sumo Logic, Snowflake, and PagerDuty.
- Lead technical scoping, estimation, architecture reviews, code reviews, and production-readiness efforts.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: New York City Metropolitan Area, New York - United States
positions.description:
- Performed manual and automated testing for large-scale internet advertising platforms, validating functionality, reliability, performance, and end-to-end user workflows. 
 - Designed and maintained test automation frameworks and scripts using Java, Selenium, Jasmine, Protractor, HTML5, and CSS3 to improve regression coverage and testing efficiency. 
 - Created comprehensive test strategies, plans, suites, and test cases, performing both white-box and black-box testing across web and mobile components. 
 - Tested Android and iOS SDK integrations, validating APIs, application behavior, and cross-platform compatibility. 
 - Debugged and analyzed HTTP/HTTPS traffic, API requests, and responses using Charles Proxy to identify integration and communication issues. 
 - Reported, tracked, and managed defects through Buganizer, collaborating with developers and cross-functional teams through resolution.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: New York City Metropolitan Area, New York - United States
positions.description:
- Performed end-to-end testing of mobile applications across iOS, Android, Windows Mobile, and BlackBerry, validating functionality, usability, compatibility, and cross-platform behavior. 
 - Developed and executed automated Android UI tests using Robotium, improving regression test coverage and repeatability. 
- Analyzed network traffic, API requests/responses, and application payloads using Fiddler and Wireshark to troubleshoot integration issues, validate backend communication, and identify defects.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Developed and maintained automated, performance, and regression test suites using Visual Studio, Coded UI, and SQL to validate application quality, stability, and data integrity. 
 - Built and tested Windows Phone 7 Silverlight applications, including the development and execution of unit tests to improve code reliability and defect detection. 
 - Designed and developed frontend applications and user interfaces using Java, HTML, and JavaScript, with a focus on functionality, usability, and cross-browser behavior.

- Flickr Search App is photo browsing app developed by using Fickr API.

projects.title: Android  project for Mobile (Photo Analytics)
projects.description:
•	Design and develop a simple photo analytics app.
•	The purpose of this project or app was to record the # of hits to photos like by end users and draw analytical data graph for business model.
•	Design and develop web service and backend architecture using Google app engine cloud and python language.
•	Develop Automation test script using Robotium to automate the process.
